rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to fully covered units, such as most multifamily units built before 1980, pre-1996 single-family tenancies and rooming houses. Newer construction (CO after June 1980), post-1996 single-family tenancies, most condominiums and certain subsidized units are registered but not rent controlled.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.status_basis: Coverage guide describes the ordinance as in force; no adoption dates stated.

rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to both fully and partially covered units, including new construction, condominiums and post-1996 single-family tenancies. Exempt units are golden duplexes, owner-shared kitchen/bath units, certain ADU properties, dormitories and nonprofit co-ops.
